facts.fact: NITA-U's slides describe UgPass services in use: passwordless strong authentication for e-services, digital signature with PKI certificates, APIs and e-seal.
NITA-U reports UgPass has 10M+ subscribers, 35+ MDAs and hundreds of service providers, including NITA eDOC, electronic government procurement and I&M Bank.
NITA-U's slides list a UgPass app among UgPass 1.0 components and show a Digital Credential Wallet and mobile digital signing in the enhanced UgPass 2.0.
